The law that let Hitler's government make laws without the Reichstag.
'Co-ordination': bringing every part of German life under Nazi control.
The Night of the Long Knives: SS units killed Röhm, other SA leaders and other opponents.
Hindenburg died; Hitler combined Chancellor and President as Führer, and the army swore loyalty to him.
The Nazi secret state police, which relied heavily on denunciations by ordinary people.

front: What was the July Bomb Plot?
back: The attempt by army officers led by Stauffenberg to kill Hitler on 20 July 1944.
A state in which one party and leader try to control every part of life through terror and propaganda.
It aimed at total control and achieved much, but it was chaotic and relied on popular co-operation as well as terror.
